poses.blink: Both eyes fully closed for a brief blink; otherwise unchanged neutral idle posture and beak.
poses.quirk1: First frame of its personality quirk: Sunny anticipates a double hop with tiny lifted wings, upright body at unchanged idle size; Skye sleepy blink with small head tilt; Berry raises a wing toward its plumes with wink; Minty raises wing toward eye ring; Cocoa begins a yawn; Flurry begins a shiver; Ember opens wings halfway; Inky glances upward; Hoot turns head left; Rook raises compass trinket.
poses.quirk2: Second frame of its personality quirk: Sunny perks upright and opens tiny wings anticipating hop; Skye eyes open and head tilted other way; Berry preens plumes with wing; Minty touches eye ring with wing as pushing glasses; Cocoa finishes big yawn; Flurry fluffs feathers in shiver; Ember flaps wings downward; Inky looks high upward; Hoot turns head right; Rook holds trinket higher. Feet remain on same baseline for runtime hop.
poses.fly_up: Both wings fully raised above shoulders, separated from body, feathers spread, clear upstroke flying pose; feet stay at same baseline for sprite anchoring, body center and size unchanged.
poses.fly_down: Both wings fully extended down and outward, clear downstroke flying pose substantially different from upstroke; feet same baseline, body center and size unchanged.
poses.cheer: Joyous celebration, smiling open beak and delighted crescent eyes, wings raised outwards.
poses.sleep: Deep peaceful sleep with both eyes closed and beak closed, wings folded, head gently nestled. NO Zzz, letters, bubbles or symbols.
poses.tilt_left: Head visibly rolled 20 degrees counterclockwise toward viewer left: viewer-left eye lower and viewer-right eye higher, crest leaning left. Body stays upright, feet unchanged.
poses.tilt_right: Head visibly rolled 20 degrees clockwise toward viewer right: viewer-right eye lower and viewer-left eye higher, crest leaning right. Mirror-consistent counterpart to tilt_left. Body stays upright, feet unchanged.
poses.look_up: Eyes and head looking upward, body and feet remain unchanged and stationary.
poses.look_down: Eyes and head looking downward toward feet, body and feet remain unchanged and stationary.
poses.look_side: Head turned toward viewer right neighbour, clear sideward gaze, body and feet remain unchanged and stationary.
poses.preen: Beak visibly tucked into its raised wing, preening feathers, body and feet stationary.
poses.fluff: Feathers visibly puffed out making silhouette slightly rounder, body center and feet stationary.
poses.stretch: One wing extended fully sideways in a clear relaxed stretch, other wing folded, body and feet stationary.
poses.yawn: Beak wide open in a large sleepy yawn, both eyes closed, body and feet stationary.

method: Built-in image_gen only; reference identity edits, then Pillow alignment/portrait crops/QA.
body_scale_contract: All swaps keep idle torso size and foot baseline. Review near 120px body width; no shrinking quirk poses. Head tilt must clearly read 15-20 degrees in each direction.
